summary: Describes how to use the GOST 28147-89, GOST R 34.10-94, GOST R 34.10-2001 and GOST R 34.11-94 cryptographic algorithms with the Cryptographic Message Syntax (CMS), which is used for signing, hashing, authenticating and encrypting messages. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Explains how to use some Russian lock-and-signature methods in a common envelope format used for secure messages.

questions: using gost algorithms in cryptographic message syntax
